context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 file download bug fix verified. Key changes: 1) Backend get_current_user (server.py line 146) now checks request.query_params.get('token') as third auth method. 2) Frontend downloadFile functions in StudentDashboard.js, InstructorDashboard.js, CohortDetail.js now use window.open(url + '?token=xxx') instead of axios blob downloads. All download endpoints tested: /api/materials/{id}/download, /api/submissions/{id}/download, /api/cohorts/{id}/students/template. Auth tokens stored in localStorage under 'thinkific_session_token'.
rca_of_the_issue: The original bug was that axios blob downloads were failing for end users despite passing automated tests. The fix changed the approach to use native browser file download via window.open() with the auth token passed as a query parameter. The backend was updated to accept the token from query params in addition to cookies and Authorization header.
